name: tests-half-kubernetes-ingress-structured-policy-40ce
instr:
Add structured Policy evaluation. Valid access-control Policies are accepted without blocking findings or errors and report namespace/name plus current generation. Invalid specifications produce FindingInvalidSpec and the same error as ValidatePolicy. OSS JWT produces FindingUnsupportedEdition. Disabled OIDC/App Protect produces FindingFeatureDisabled independently of valid fields. OIDC runtime readiness cannot validate invalid OIDCNative fields. WAF runtime readiness changes findings and acceptance independently of enablement. Repeated evaluation preserves finding order.

EvaluatePolicyUse rejects BasicAuth for Ingress with FindingUnsupportedConsumer and accepts it for VirtualServer with ready dependencies. Preserve Policy identity/generation and specification findings across consumers. Missing dependencies produce blocking consumer-associated findings; invalid dependencies differ from pending ones. Ready dependencies clear obsolete dependency findings and allow acceptance when no independent blocker remains. Preserve independent capability findings on recovery; a later invalid dependency restores blocking.

Aggregate preserves reference order, Policy identity, consumer, field, message and distinct reasons. Retain nonblocking findings without rejecting accepted reports; a later blocking report rejects the aggregate while retaining earlier findings.

PolicyStatus supports independent validity, support, readiness and usability conditions with generation, reason and message. JS
